title: Internal error: "TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not iterable" in incremental mode
body:
Python 3.5.2, mypy 2e2a94e30724f061a835eb2f72a89115250a37ee

Steps to reproduce (structure extracted from a larger application, I could probably simplify it further but this should be good enough):

```
mkdir -p testdir/package/subpackage
touch \
    testdir/package/__init__.py \
    testdir/package/subpackage/__init__.py \
    testdir/package/subpackage/mod2.py

echo "from package.subpackage.mod1 import Class

def handle(c: Class) -> None:
    c.some_attribute" > testdir/main.py

echo "import six

class Class(object): pass" > testdir/package/subpackage/mod1.py

rm -rf .mypy_cache

python -m mypy --silent-imports --incremental testdir/main.py testdir/package/subpackage/mod2.py
python -m mypy --show-traceback --silent-imports --incremental testdir/main.py testdir/package/subpackage/mod1.py
```
